rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an express train or other fast transport service.

example.english: We took the express to Guangzhou, so we didn't have to stop at so many stations.
example.traditional: 我哋搭快車去廣州，唔使停咁多站。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 faai3 ce1 heoi3 gwong2 zau1 m4 sai2 ting4 gam3 do1 zaam6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for conveying feelings, ideas, or messages.

example.english: I don't know how to express my feelings.
example.traditional: 我唔識得點樣表達自己嘅感受。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 sik1 dak1 dim2 joeng6 biu2 daat6 zi6 gei2 ge3 gam2 sau6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on stating something clearly or making it explicit.

example.english: If you have any demands, express them clearly; there's no need to beat around the bush.
example.traditional: 你有咩要求就講明啦，唔使兜圈子。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 me1 jiu1 kau4 zau6 gong2 ming4 laa1 m4 sai2 dau1 hyun1 zi2

rows.note: Use this especially for expressing an attitude, position, intention, or reaction.

example.english: They use their actions to express their support for us.
example.traditional: 佢哋用行動表示支持我哋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 hang4 dung6 biu2 si6 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this for an express delivery or mail service rather than for money transfers.

example.english: Send this document by express, and it’ll arrive tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢份文件用速遞寄，聽日就到。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 jung6 cuk1 dai6 gei3 ting1 jat6 zau6 dou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a rapid money-transfer service.

example.english: I want to use an express money-transfer service to send money to my family.
example.traditional: 我想用特快匯款畀屋企人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jung6 dak6 faai3 wui6 fun2 bei2 uk1 kei2 jan4
